question: Keeping a film master costs $1,059 a year; a 4K digital master, $12,514. Extra for 100 titles over 10 years, in millions of dollars?
move: Count what it costs to keep a thing, not only to make it.
trap: Assuming digital storage is cheap because disks keep getting cheaper.
hint: Find the extra cost of one title for one year first.
steps: 12,514 − 1,059 = 11,455 dollars extra per title per year.
reference: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences Science and Technology Council, The Digital Dilemma: Strategic Issues in Archiving and Accessing Digital Motion Picture Materials, 2007
